def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-prepara.physical_scope: Nonrelativistic classical point-particle models whose thermodynamic claims concern positions and pair interactions; kinetic momentum variables are outside this definition.

def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-prepara:
## Definition

Fix an integer spatial dimension $d\geq 1$, a reference length $\ell_0>0$, and a bounded measurable region $\Lambda\subset\mathbb R^d$ with dimensionless volume $V=|\Lambda|$. Its physical region is $\ell_0\Lambda$. A finite positional configuration of $N$ classical point particles in $\Lambda$ is an unordered simple set $\omega=\{x_1,\ldots,x_N\}\subset\Lambda$; simple means that no point is repeated. Particle number $N$ is a dimensionless nonnegative integer and the physical number density corresponding to $N/V$ is $N/(\ell_0^dV)$.

A pair potential is an even measurable function $\varphi:\mathbb R^d\to\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$, where $\varphi(x)$ is the interaction energy in joules at physical displacement $\ell_0x$ and evenness means $\varphi(x)=\varphi(-x)$. For a labelled representative of $\omega$, define the positional pair energy
$$H_N(\omega)=\sum_{1\leq i<j\leq N}\varphi(x_i-x_j),\qquad H_0=H_1=0.$$
If any pair is forbidden by the potential, its energy and hence $H_N$ are $+\infty$. This model contains no kinetic energy, internal molecular coordinates, quantum exchange terms, or external field.

The interaction is stable if there is a constant $B\geq0$, measured in joules, such that $H_N(\omega)\geq-BN$ for every finite simple configuration. It has a regular integrable tail if there are $R>0$ and a nonnegative nonincreasing measurable function $\psi:[R,\infty)\to[0,\infty)$, measured in joules, such that $|\varphi(x)|\leq\psi(|x|)$ for $|x|\geq R$ and
$$\int_R^\infty r^{d-1}\psi(r)\,dr<\infty.$$
A stable potential with this tail condition is the stable regularly tempered class used for the free-cube results on this page. Superstability and a positive divergent core are stronger, separate hypotheses and are not implied by stability.

At temperature $T>0$, write $\beta=(k_BT)^{-1}$ in joules inverse. The activity $z>0$ is dimensionless relative to the reference intensity $\ell_0^{-d}$. A free-wall finite-volume model contains only positions in $\Lambda$ and uses $H_N$ above. A periodic model uses the declared periodic cell and sums its periodic-image pair interactions with each unordered pair counted once. These are distinct boundary preparations. The limits on this page are positional configurational limits and do not by themselves include a momentum integral or a full phase-space energy shell.

def-td-admissible-van-hove-and-tempered-.physical_scope: Classical positional pair-potential models in dimension d at least two, with free walls, periodic walls, or the explicitly bounded deterministic exterior class defined here.

def-td-admissible-van-hove-and-tempered-:
## Definition

Use the dimensionless coordinates, simple configurations, and pair potential of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]]. A sequence $(\Lambda_k)_{k\geq1}$ of bounded measurable regions is van Hove if $|\Lambda_k|\to\infty$ and, for every fixed $s>0$,
$$\frac{|\{x\in\Lambda_k:\operatorname{dist}(x,\partial\Lambda_k)\leq s\}|}{|\Lambda_k|}\longrightarrow0.$$
This is an explicit condition on the boundary-layer volume; increasing volume alone does not imply it. A free wall permits particles only in $\Lambda_k$ and includes no exterior particles. A periodic wall uses the specified periodic cell and its image convention.

For the deterministic exterior class, let $C=[-1/2,1/2)^d$ and $\Lambda_n=[-n-1/2,n+1/2)^d$, with $V_n=|\Lambda_n|$. For a locally finite exterior configuration $\zeta\subset\mathbb R^d$, write $N_{C+i}(\zeta)=|\zeta\cap(C+i)|$. Given $t<\infty$, define
$$\Omega(t)=\left\{\zeta:\sum_{i\in\Lambda_n\cap\mathbb Z^d}N_{C+i}(\zeta)^2\leq tV_n\ \text{for every integer }n\geq0\right\}.$$
For an interior configuration $\omega\subset\Lambda_n$, its exterior interaction is
$$W_n(\omega,\zeta)=\sum_{x\in\omega}\sum_{y\in\zeta\setminus\Lambda_n}\varphi(x-y),$$
interpreted as an extended-real sum. A positive infinite value has zero Boltzmann weight. The regular tail controls distant terms; the class $\Omega(t)$ is a fixed uniform bound on exterior cell counts, not permission for an arbitrary volume-filling external potential. The van Hove and uniformly tempered exterior conditions are separate boundary regimes.

post-td-classical-indistinguishable-part.physical_scope: Classical models of identical point particles of one species represented only by their positions in a fixed finite spatial region; it does not assert quantum statistics or include momentum states.

post-td-classical-indistinguishable-part:
## Postulate

Adopt the unlabelled positional configuration measure $\mu_{\Lambda,N}$ obtained from labelled tuples by dividing by permutation multiplicity. Thus, for every nonnegative measurable symmetric function $f$ on $\Lambda^N$,
$$\int f(\omega)\,\mu_{\Lambda,N}(d\omega)=\frac1{N!}\int_{\Lambda^N}f(\{x_1,\ldots,x_N\})\,d^{dN}x.$$
The reference coordinates and length scale are those of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]]. This convention treats two labelled lists that differ only by a particle permutation as the same positional state. The factor $1/N!$ is an adopted indistinguishable-particle measure convention for this classical model, not a theorem that classical trajectories or every classical description must use quotient states.

For later comparison, define the unit-intensity Poisson reference on a finite region by
$$Q_\Lambda(d\omega)=e^{-|\Lambda|}\sum_{N=0}^{\infty}\mu_{\Lambda,N}(d\omega).$$
Its total mass is one because $\mu_{\Lambda,N}$ has total mass $|\Lambda|^N/N!$ and $e^{-|\Lambda|}\sum_{N\geq0}|\Lambda|^N/N!=1$. This is a positional reference measure in the chosen dimensionless coordinates; it supplies no empirical claim about particle trajectories.

def-td-controlled-fixed-n-energy-shell.physical_scope: Finite periodic boxes of the classical pair-potential positional model; shells constrain pair configuration energy only and exclude kinetic momentum energy.

def-td-controlled-fixed-n-energy-shell:
## Definition

Use the periodic boxes $\Lambda_n$ and positional energy of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]], and the exact-$N$ measure $\mu_{\Lambda_n,N}$ of [[post-td-classical-indistinguishable-particle-measure]]. Given $N_n\in\mathbb N$, a reduced configuration-energy center $e\in\mathbb R$ joules per dimensionless reference volume, and a width $\delta_n>0$ in the same units, define
$$S_n(N_n,e,\delta_n)=\{\omega\subset\Lambda_n:|\omega|=N_n,\ |H_{N_n}^{\mathrm{per}}(\omega)/V_n-e|\leq\delta_n\}.$$
When $0<\mu_{\Lambda_n,N_n}(S_n)<\infty$, the uniform positional shell law is
$$M_n(A)=\frac{\mu_{\Lambda_n,N_n}(A\cap S_n)}{\mu_{\Lambda_n,N_n}(S_n)}.$$
A shrinking energy-density shell uses some specified sequence $\delta_n\downarrow0$. Its total energy width is $2\delta_nV_n$, which is $o(V_n)$ but need not be microscopic or bounded. Existence of a normalizing shell and the existence of a suitable shrinking sequence are separate theorem obligations. This is not a surface measure on an exact-energy hypersurface and not a phase-space shell for $K(p)+H_N^{\mathrm{per}}$.

def-td-retained-hard-core-zero-beta-prep.physical_scope: Finite-volume positional models with forbidden pair separations; this is a declared beta-zero hard-admissibility continuation, not a claim about all infinite-temperature physical preparations.

def-td-retained-hard-core-zero-beta-prep:
## Definition

For the pair potential $\varphi$ of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]], let $B=\{x\in\mathbb R^d:\varphi(x)=+\infty\}$. A finite configuration is hard-admissible if every pair displacement avoids $B$. For $z>0$, define the retained-admissibility zero-inverse-temperature weight of $\omega$ to be
$$w_0(\omega)=z^{N(\omega)}\mathbf 1_{\{H_{N(\omega)}(\omega)<\infty\}}.$$
Its finite-volume partition sum, when finite, is $\Xi_{\Lambda}^{\mathrm{ret},0}(z)=\sum_{N\geq0}\int w_0(\omega)\,\mu_{\Lambda,N}(d\omega)$, using [[post-td-classical-indistinguishable-particle-measure]]. This definition sets the weight of a forbidden configuration to zero; it does not assign a value to the undefined product $0\cdot(+\infty)$. When $B=\varnothing$ the measure is the unrestricted Poisson activity model; for a nonempty hard core it is generally not Poisson. The convention is explicit model data and carries no statement about an arbitrary zero-width energy shell.

post-td-equilibrium-ensemble-sampling.physical_scope: Adopted canonical, grand-canonical, and positional microcanonical preparations of a classical pair-potential model in a stated finite region; no dynamical relaxation, ergodicity, or empirical thermalization is asserted.

post-td-equilibrium-ensemble-sampling:
## Postulate

For a specified finite region and boundary preparation, take $T>0$, $\beta=(k_BT)^{-1}$, and the positional energy in [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]]. For each fixed $N$, specialize the measurable-model canonical preparation of [[post-td-canonical-sampling]] to the dimensionless positional configuration measure $\mu_{\Lambda,N}$; adopt the law
$$P_{\Lambda,N}^{\mathrm{can}}(d\omega)=Z_{\Lambda,N}^{-1}e^{-\beta H_N(\omega)}\mu_{\Lambda,N}(d\omega),\qquad Z_{\Lambda,N}=\int e^{-\beta H_N}\,d\mu_{\Lambda,N},$$
whenever $0<Z_{\Lambda,N}<\infty$. Separately adopt the grand-canonical law at activity $z>0$ to have weights $z^{N(\omega)}e^{-\beta H_{N(\omega)}(\omega)}$ relative to the same indistinguishable positional measures; its normalizer is $\Xi_\Lambda(z,\beta)=\sum_{N\geq0}z^NZ_{\Lambda,N}$ when finite. Here $z$ is dimensionless relative to the reference intensity in [[post-td-classical-indistinguishable-particle-measure]], and $\alpha=\log z$.

For the controlled positional shell of [[def-td-controlled-fixed-n-energy-shell]], adopt the conditional measure $M_n$ only when its shell has positive finite reference measure. These are probability-law preparations used to define the model. They are not derived from Hamiltonian trajectories, and they do not assert that a laboratory apparatus reaches any of them. The inverse-temperature-zero hard-core continuation is governed separately by [[def-td-retained-hard-core-zero-beta-preparation]].

post-td-grand-variational-phase-uniquene.physical_scope: Only a named model and parameter point on the positive-temperature Gibbs branch or the explicitly retained hard-core beta-zero branch for which the corresponding translation-invariant variational minimizer is assumed unique; no universal uniqueness or claim at coexistence.

post-td-grand-variational-phase-uniquene:
## Postulate

Fix the selected stable regularly tempered pair model, $T>0$, $\beta=(k_BT)^{-1}$, and activity $z>0$. For the superstable branch, require an explicit decomposition $\varphi=\varphi_s+\varphi_r$ where $\varphi_s$ is stable and there is a $\delta>0$ such that $\varphi_r(x)\geq\delta\mathbf 1_{\{|x|\leq\delta\}}$. This is an additional model hypothesis, not a consequence of stability alone.

A probability law $P$ on locally finite simple configurations is stationary if it is invariant under every spatial translation. Let $P_{\Lambda_L}$ and $Q_{\Lambda_L}$ be its restriction and the unit-intensity Poisson reference of [[post-td-classical-indistinguishable-particle-measure]] to a centered cube $\Lambda_L$. For probability measures $P_0,Q_0$, define $D(P_0\|Q_0)=\int \log(dP_0/dQ_0)\,dP_0$ if $P_0$ is absolutely continuous with respect to $Q_0$, and $D=+\infty$ otherwise. Let $C=[-1/2,1/2)^d$ and define $\rho(P)=P(N_C)$. On stationary laws for which the finite limits exist, define
$$I(P)=\lim_{L\to\infty}\frac{D(P_{\Lambda_L}\|Q_{\Lambda_L})}{|\Lambda_L|},\qquad \Phi(P)=\lim_{L\to\infty}\frac{P(H_{\Lambda_L}^{\mathrm{free}})}{|\Lambda_L|}.$$
For $\beta>0$, use the stationary laws with finite $I(P)$ and $\Phi(P)$ and adopt, at the selected $(\varphi,\beta,z)$, that
$$\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{P}\{I(P)+\beta\Phi(P)-\rho(P)\log z\}=\{P^\ast\}.$$

For the $\beta=0$ branch, require a nonempty hard-core displacement set $B=\{x:\varphi(x)=+\infty\}$ and use [[def-td-retained-hard-core-zero-beta-preparation]]. Restrict to stationary laws supported on hard-admissible configurations with finite $I(P)$ and adopt, at the selected $z$, that
$$\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{P}\{I(P)-\rho(P)\log z\}=\{P^\ast\}.$$
These are two explicit parameter-specific physical model restrictions. They do not assert uniqueness for every activity or temperature, do not apply at coexistence when the minimizer set has several elements, and do not infer uniqueness from thermodynamic smoothness.

pthm-td-stable-tempered-free-cube-grand-.physical_scope: Positive-temperature grand-canonical positional preparations in cubic free-wall boxes for stable even Borel pair potentials with the explicitly stated decreasing integrable tail.

pthm-td-stable-tempered-free-cube-grand-:
## Statement

Assume AC. Let $d\geq2$, $\varphi$ be stable with the regular integrable tail of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]], and assume its dimensionless representative $\widehat\varphi=\varphi/E_0$ is Borel measurable, as required by the current mathematical supplier. Take $E_0=1\,\mathrm J$, $\beta=(k_BT)^{-1}$, and $\widehat\beta=E_0\beta>0$. For cubes $\Lambda_L=[-L/2,L/2)^d$, let $\Xi_L(z,\beta)$ be the free-wall grand partition function specified by [[post-td-equilibrium-ensemble-sampling]]. Then the positional grand pressure
$$p_L(z,T)=\frac{k_BT}{\ell_0^d|\Lambda_L|}\log\Xi_L(z,\beta)$$
has a finite limit as $L\to\infty$. In the dimensionless reference-volume convention of [[thm-tdmath-canonical-grand-duality]], let $P(\alpha,\widehat\beta)=\lim_{L\to\infty}|\Lambda_L|^{-1}\log\Xi_L(e^\alpha,\widehat\beta)$, where the supplier uses numerical energies in units of $E_0$. Then $p=(k_BT/\ell_0^d)P(\log z,\widehat\beta)$. This is a conditional model deduction, not a measurement or an assertion that every real gas realizes the preparation.

pthm-td-controlled-continuum-thermodynam.physical_scope: Superstable regular classical positional pair systems in periodic cubes at positive temperature, together with the expressly defined formal retained-hard-admissibility zero-inverse-temperature branch, with a nondegenerate density interval and strict upper-energy threshold; periodically continued local convergence requires the stated unique minimizer.

pthm-td-controlled-continuum-thermodynam:
## Statement

Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB, as required by the current variational-pressure supplier. Let $E_0=1\,\mathrm J$, $\widehat\varphi=\varphi/E_0$, and assume $\widehat\varphi$ is Borel measurable. Require the exact superstable regular hypotheses of [[def-tdmath-superstable-regular-interaction]] for this dimensionless potential: a stable part plus a nonnegative core part bounded below by a positive constant on an $\ell^\infty$-ball, with the supplier's lower and upper regular tail conditions. Use $\widehat H=H/E_0$, $\widehat\beta=E_0\beta$ for $\beta>0$, and $\widehat e=e/E_0$; then $\beta H=\widehat\beta\widehat H$. For this supplier convention, let $\nu$ be the supremum of finite-entropy, finite-energy attainable densities for $\widehat\varphi$, and write $\widehat\Phi(P)$ for the supplier's limiting positional energy density; let $e_0(\rho)=\inf\{\widehat\Phi(P):\rho(P)=\rho,\ I(P)<\infty\}$ be its numerical positional-energy infimum. Let $D\subset[0,\infty)$ be a nondegenerate density interval, and require $\inf D<\nu$ and $\widehat e>\inf_{\rho\in D}e_0(\rho)$. Use periodic boxes and the density-interval/upper-energy conditional preparation. For $\beta>0$, the finite-volume grand and microcanonical weights are those of [[post-td-equilibrium-ensemble-sampling]]. For $\beta=0$, require a nonempty hard-core displacement set and use the formal retained-admissibility continuation of [[def-td-retained-hard-core-zero-beta-preparation]]; do not interpret $0\cdot(+\infty)$.

For both the positive-$\beta$ branch and the formal retained-hard-core $\beta=0$ branch, [[thm-tdmath-interval-event-ensemble-limit]] gives eventual event positivity, the constrained entropy-rate limit, and common-minimizer accumulation points; at $\beta=0$, [[thm-tdmath-retained-hard-zero-beta-limit]] identifies the matching retained grand law and minimizer set. If the relevant common minimizer set is the singleton adopted in [[post-td-grand-variational-phase-uniqueness]] for the multiplier pair supplied by that branch, both the conditioned laws and the corresponding periodic grand laws converge locally to $P^\ast$ for every measurable local observable $f$ with $|f|\leq c(1+N_A)$ on a bounded region $A$. This is an interval-density and upper-energy result, not a fixed-particle-number or shrinking-shell theorem.


Here local observables are evaluated on the periodic continuation of the prepared torus configuration. This is the same periodic boundary preparation, with no new physical sampling assumption; a configuration is not extended by the empty configuration outside its fundamental cube.

pthm-td-controlled-thermodynamic-ensembl.physical_scope: Stable regularly tempered classical positional Borel pair models at positive temperature, for the closed concave extension of the attainable canonical rate; no local-observable equivalence is asserted.

pthm-td-controlled-thermodynamic-ensembl:
## Statement

Assume AC and $T>0$, with $\beta=(k_BT)^{-1}$. Under the stable regularly tempered positional model of [[def-td-stable-tempered-continuum-preparation]] and the adopted ensemble weights of [[post-td-equilibrium-ensemble-sampling]], assume the dimensionless potential $\widehat\varphi=\varphi/E_0$ is Borel measurable as required by the current mathematical carriers. Set $E_0=1\,\mathrm J$ and $\widehat\beta=E_0\beta$; write $F(\rho,\beta)$ and $P(\alpha,\beta)$ for the mathematical rates evaluated at $\widehat\beta$. Let $F(\rho,\beta)$ be the canonical log-partition rate per dimensionless reference volume, defined on interior attainable densities by the fixed-density limit and extended to the closed effective density domain by the upper-semicontinuous concave extension specified in [[thm-tdmath-canonical-grand-duality]]. Let
$$P(\alpha,\beta)=\lim_{V\to\infty}V^{-1}\log\sum_{N\geq0}e^{\alpha N}Z(V,N),\qquad \alpha=\log z.$$
Then
$$P(\alpha,\beta)=\sup_{\rho\geq0}\{F(\rho,\beta)+\alpha\rho\},\qquad F(\rho,\beta)=\inf_{\alpha\in\mathbb R}\{P(\alpha,\beta)-\alpha\rho\}.$$
In physical units, $p=(k_BT/\ell_0^d)P$ and the positional Helmholtz free-energy density is $f_{\mathrm{pos}}=-(k_BT/\ell_0^d)F$, with the fixed reference normalization of [[post-td-classical-indistinguishable-particle-measure]]. This duality concerns limiting thermodynamic functions only. It does not imply local ensemble equivalence, uniqueness of a phase, or convergence at excluded density endpoints.

pthm-td-interacting-three-ensemble-local.physical_scope: Superstable regular classical positional Borel pair systems in periodic boxes, at positive temperature and interior density, with differentiable canonical rate and a singleton grand variational minimizer; local observables use the same periodic continuation, and kinetic momentum is excluded.

pthm-td-interacting-three-ensemble-local:
## Statement

Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB as required by the current variational-pressure supplier. Let $E_0=1\,\mathrm J$, $\widehat\varphi=\varphi/E_0$, and assume $\widehat\varphi$ is Borel measurable. Require the exact superstable regular hypotheses of [[def-tdmath-superstable-regular-interaction]]; use $\widehat H=H/E_0$ and $\widehat\beta=E_0\beta>0$ in its mathematical suppliers. Let $F(\rho,\beta)$ denote the numerical canonical rate evaluated at $\widehat\beta$; assume it is differentiable in physical $\beta$ at the chosen temperature and set $e=-\partial_\beta F(\rho,\beta)$, in joules per dimensionless reference volume. For periodic cubes $\Lambda_n$, take exact particle numbers $N_n$ with $N_n/V_n\to\rho$ at a positive interior attainable density. Choose a finite supporting activity parameter $\alpha$ for $F$ at $\rho$ and set $z=e^\alpha>0$; assume the corresponding stationary grand variational minimizer is the singleton $P^\ast$ as in [[post-td-grand-variational-phase-uniqueness]].

Then there exists a constructed sequence $\delta_n\downarrow0$ for which the periodic exact-$N_n$ canonical positional law, the periodic grand-canonical law at $(\alpha,\beta)$, and the uniform positional shell law of [[def-td-controlled-fixed-n-energy-shell]] on
$$N=N_n,\qquad |H_{N_n}^{\mathrm{per}}/V_n-e|\leq\delta_n$$
all converge locally to $P^\ast$. Convergence means convergence of expectations for every measurable local observable $f$ supported in a bounded region and satisfying $|f|\leq c(1+N_A)$ there. The shell sequence is constructed from canonical concentration; arbitrary preassigned shrinking widths, exact zero-width surfaces, full phase-space shells involving kinetic momentum, and a conclusion at nonunique minimizers are not asserted.

Here local observables are evaluated on the periodic continuation of the prepared torus configuration. This is the same periodic boundary preparation, with no new physical sampling assumption; a configuration is not extended by the empty configuration outside its fundamental cube.

pthm-td-qualified-van-hove-and-exterior-.physical_scope: Classical positional Borel pair systems in dimension at least two; van Hove free-wall limits require superstability and regularity, while deterministic exterior limits additionally require a genuine positive divergent core in the supplier's infinity norm and a fixed uniformly tempered exterior class.

pthm-td-qualified-van-hove-and-exterior-:
## Statement

Assume AC, as required by the current mathematical definition and its shape suppliers. Let $d\geq2$, $E_0=1\,\mathrm J$, $\widehat\varphi=\varphi/E_0$, and assume $\widehat\varphi$ is Borel measurable and superstable and regular as in [[def-tdmath-superstable-regular-interaction]]. Use $\widehat H=H/E_0$ and $\widehat\beta=E_0(k_BT)^{-1}>0$ in the mathematical rates. Let $(\Lambda_k)$ be a van Hove sequence as in [[def-td-admissible-van-hove-and-tempered-exterior]]. First, for free walls, the positional grand pressure along $\Lambda_k$ converges to the free-cube pressure of [[pthm-td-stable-tempered-free-cube-grand-pressure]]. For any positive interior attainable density $\rho$ and exact integers $N_k$ with $N_k/|\Lambda_k|\to\rho$, the exact-$N_k$ free-wall canonical log-partition rate converges to the same cube canonical rate. These two shape statements require superstability and regularity; stability alone is not asserted to suffice for arbitrary van Hove shapes.

Second, strengthen the potential hypothesis: for some $r_0>0$, $\widehat\varphi(x)\geq\widehat\chi(\|x\|_\infty)>0$ whenever $0<\|x\|_\infty\leq r_0$, where $\widehat\chi$ is nonincreasing and $\int_0^{r_0}\widehat\chi(r)r^{d-1}\,dr=+\infty$. For each fixed $t<\infty$, the free-wall grand pressure in $\Lambda_n$ with exterior $\zeta\in\Omega(t)$ then converges uniformly in $\zeta$ to the same free-cube pressure. The exterior interaction is the deterministic positional term of [[def-td-admissible-van-hove-and-tempered-exterior]], not a volume-filling external field. This genuine divergent-core condition is the exact stronger hypothesis of the current exterior supplier; it is not inferred from superstability or replaced by a weaker source condition.

ex-td-two-particle-hard-core-preparation.physical_scope: A finite one-dimensional positional toy model with two classical identical particles and a hard-core exclusion; it is a model calculation, not a reported measurement.

ex-td-nonunique-variational-phases.physical_scope: A dimensionless coarse-grained order-parameter example illustrating a possible failure of a singleton variational-minimizer assumption; it is not a continuum Gibbs-potential calculation.

ex-td-forbidden-pair-beta-zero.physical_scope: A finite-volume positional hard-core model under the explicitly defined retained-admissibility beta-zero continuation; no universal infinite-temperature claim is made.

ex-td-volume-sized-external-field.physical_scope: A finite-dimensional classical ideal positional gas with a constant per-particle external energy throughout the volume; it is excluded from the fixed uniformly tempered exterior class.
